title: Extract the check-notice machinery and its silent_check_outcome tests out of engram_turn_checks.rs and its test file
outcome: The holder-notice machinery (engram_unrecorded_check_line, EngramUnendedClosure, engram_close_unended_checks, engram_late_end_line, engram_check_settlement_notices, engram_publish_check_notice) lives in its own module (for example engram_check_notices.rs), and its silent_check_outcome_* tests in their own test file, as a pure code move, so engram_turn_checks.rs and src/tests/engram_turn_checks.rs fall back below the architecture lens's size thresholds.
acceptance: The listed notice functions and EngramUnendedClosure are moved, unchanged, to a new module with the provenance header CLAUDE.md requires, and the silent_check_outcome_* tests to a new test file; no behaviour, name or signature changes.
src/engram_turn_checks.rs is below 3000 lines and src/tests/engram_turn_checks.rs below 5000 lines after the move.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
